decisions.historical_action: USA called an official 60s timeout trailing 34-39 and substituted Sarah Adam (2.5 F) out for Josh Wheeler (2.5 M), fielding Chuck Aoki (3.0), Josh Wheeler (2.5), Lee Fredette (1.0), and Josh O'Neill (1.5) [8.0 pts].

pre_decision_timeline.description: Yukinobu Ike scores on fast break (JPN 39 - USA 34)
USA calls 60-second tactical timeout trailing by 5

observed_aftermath_timeline.description: Sarah Adam exits, Josh Wheeler enters
Josh O'Neill scores try for USA (JPN 39 - USA 35)
Katsuya Hashimoto scores for Japan (JPN 40 - USA 35)
Josh Wheeler commits handling turnover out of bounds
Lee Fredette exits, Jeff Butler enters; Josh O'Neill exits, Sarah Adam enters
Yukinobu Ike converts turnover try (JPN 41 - USA 35)
Chuck Aoki scores for USA (JPN 41 - USA 36)
Yukinobu Ike scores for Japan (JPN 42 - USA 36)

counterfactual_lineups.lineup_name: Maintain Sarah Adam Press-Break (Aoki + Adam + Fredette + Butler)
counterfactual_lineups.rationale: Retains dual-handler backcourt speed against Japan's Norimatsu/Kurahashi trap, reducing turnover hazard under 12s clock.

counterfactual_lineups.lineup_name: Standard Lockdown Power (Aoki + Wheeler + Butler + Adam)
counterfactual_lineups.rationale: Primary starting 8.5 unit providing maximum physical key presence against Hashimoto/Ike.

decisions.tactical_recommendation: The 60s timeout was tactically justified to halt Japan's momentum, but removing Sarah Adam at 5:31 left USA vulnerable to backcourt trap pressure, resulting in the critical 4:50 turnover.
